**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 75.67%

**Overview:**  
Jaya Unity Precision Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited manufacturing firm in Sarawak that specialises in precision machining of metal parts for electronics. The company was incorporated on 23 March 1988 and has five directors. Its authorized share capital is 250,000 and the top shareholder controls 75.67% of the equity. Reported revenues are 11,889,417; 13,431,881; and 16,145,308 in the most recent three periods, with equity values of 3,446,112; 3,112,848; and 3,634,461 respectively. No legal cases are recorded.
